provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: X-Wing Miniatures Game rulebook (FFG, 1st edition core set)

steps.text: One player takes the Rebels, the other the Imperials (random if you disagree)
Rebel: Luke Skywalker; Imperial: Night Beast and 1 Obsidian Squadron Pilot
Agree a squad point total (100 recommended; 31 with only the core box)
Each player secretly picks Ship and Upgrade cards up to the total; reveal together
Assemble each ship: token on the base (arc over the chevron), 2 pegs, then the ship
Each player's Ship cards faceup outside the play area, in view
Shield tokens on each Ship card equal to its shield value (blue number)
A 3' x 3' flat area (a playmat or cloth helps); sit on opposite edges
Shuffle the Damage deck facedown beside the area; dice, ruler, templates and tokens in reach
Place ships from lowest to highest pilot skill, each within Range 1 of its owner's edge, facing any way
steps.note: Ties: the player with initiative places first

steps.text: The Imperial player has initiative (squad building: the lower point total does)
Round: Planning (dials), Activation (low to high skill), Combat (high to low), End
Planning Phase: each player secretly sets a maneuver dial for every ship
